text: dsh-ui-background 为 DSH Web 客户端增加本地图片或视频壁纸和毛玻璃外观。插件由主机端提供设置状态、文件上传和壁纸读取接口，客户端在“背景与玻璃”设置页管理背景，并覆盖界面主题令牌以调整半透明效果。用户可从上传文件或本机路径选择媒体，调整填充方式、缩放、位置、模糊与明暗，还可浏览 Steam 壁纸工坊中可直接播放的媒体并回用最近背景。背景和状态存储在本机 DSH 插件目录，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ui-background adds local image or video wallpapers and translucent styling to DSH Web. Users can choose uploaded media or a local path, adjust framing and appearance, and restore recent backgrounds. Settings and uploads stay in local plugin storage; no API key or external service is needed.
想给 DSH 网页版换成本机的图片或视频背景。
能不能让 DSH 的界面半透明，并调整壁纸的缩放和位置？
I want to use a local video as the background in the DSH web interface.
dsh-ui-background 的功能「本地壁纸与构图」：在“背景与玻璃”设置页选择上传的图片/视频或本机路径，并调整填充、缩放、位置、模糊和明暗；视频在页面不可见时暂停。
dsh-ui-background 的功能「玻璃界面与背景历史」：客户端通过主题令牌调整界面透明度，并提供最近背景列表供用户快速切换和删除；工作坊页面列出可直接播放的媒体。

dsh-ui-background README · dsh-ui-background：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-background)
[](./LICENSE)
[](https://nodejs.org)

给 **DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端**加一层本地背景（图片 / 视频）+ 全界面毛玻璃。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

> 装完**必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建）。
> 状态：`0.8.2`，在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 上开发与验证。RC 阶段内部契约会变，升级 DSH 后请重新验收。

dsh-ui-background README · 它是什么（以及为什么不卡）：毛玻璃**不靠扫描 DOM**，而是改官方主题令牌：

```js
ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-ui-background', {
  '--dsw-alias-bg-base':         { light: 'rgba(255,255,255,.62)', dark: '…' },
  '--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill': { light: '…', dark: '…' },
  // 另外 3 个抬升面 / 弹层令牌

DSH 的 `body`、主框架、侧栏本来就用这些令牌画背景，所以：

- 零 DOM 扫描、零 `MutationObserver`、零逐面板 `backdrop-filter`
- 关掉 = 撤销令牌层，界面**立刻回到出厂样式**，无残留
- 背景层是**一个** `position:fixed; z-index:-1` 的图层（图片走纯 CSS，视频走一个 `<video>`）
section: 它是什么（以及为什么不卡）

text:
dsh-ui-background README · 功能：- 背景来源：上传文件 / 本机路径（只读，不复制不移动）
- 视频背景：`mp4` / `webm` 循环播放，切到后台自动暂停
- 构图：`铺满(cover)` / `完整(contain)`、缩放 50–300%、水平/垂直位置，**预览里可直接拖动**
- 壁纸引擎：自动扫 Steam 工坊 `431960`，**只列出可直接播放的**（视频/图片）
- 最近使用：最多 12 条，带缩略图与**构图参数**，一键切回，可单条删除
- 上传文件可单个删除；删到正在用的那张会自动关掉背景
- 全部本地：不联网、不收集数据

dsh-ui-background README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

**装完必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建，新装的包当次不可导入）。

重启后：设置 → **背景与玻璃**。

dsh-ui-background README · 适合什么场景：- 用本地图片或视频当背景，界面跟着半透明
- 换图之后不用重新调构图：每条历史记录里都存着缩放与位置

做不到的：Wallpaper Engine 的 Scene 渲染。`scene.pkg` 需要它自己的引擎，本插件只读图片和视频文件。

dsh-ui-background README · 已知限制：| 限制 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| Scene 壁纸不能当背景 | `scene.pkg` 是 Wallpaper Engine 私有格式，需要它的引擎渲染；包里没有现成图片 |
| 别拿 WE 预览图凑数 | 实测预览图只有 **144–254 px**，铺满 1920 宽会糊 7–13 倍 |
| 想要 WE 画面 → 截图 | 开着 WE，`Win+Shift+S` 截屏后点「粘贴截图」（1920×1080，清晰） |
| `mkv` / `mov` 可能不播 | Edge 不支持这些容器，用 `mp4` / `webm` |
| 半透明会影响所有用基础背景令牌的地方 | 代码块顶栏、图片占位、弹层遮罩都会跟着透明，这是同一套令牌的代价 |

dsh-ui-background README · 安全：- Host 端只读**你在设置里显式填写的**那一个本机文件，以及 Steam 工坊目录里的 `project.json` / 媒体 / 预览图
- HTTP 路由仅回环；写操作拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`
- 上传目录内的文件名已净化，不接受路径穿越
- 状态存在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-ui-background/`（`state.json` + `backgrounds/`），卸载插件**不会**自动删除，请自行清理

dsh-ui-background README · 开发：```bash
node selftest.mjs   # 用假 Cordis 上下文挂载 host 半身，直接打自己的 HTTP 处理器
```

`lib` 端只依赖 `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:os`，没有 npm 运行时依赖。

dsh-ui-background README · dsh-ui-background：Local image/video wallpaper plus a full-window frosted-glass treatment for the **DeepSeek Harness Web client**.

> Status: `0.8.0`, developed and verified against **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**. Harness internals move during the RC period — re-verify after upgrading.

dsh-ui-background README · What it is (and why it does not stutter)：The glass is **not** produced by scanning the DOM. It overrides the official theme tokens:

```js
ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-ui-background', {
  '--dsw-alias-bg-base':         { light: 'rgba(255,255,255,.62)', dark: '…' },
  '--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill': { light: '…', dark: '…' },
  // plus three raised-surface / overlay tokens

DSH paints `body`, the app frame and the sidebar with those tokens, so:
section: What it is (and why it does not stutter)

text:
dsh-ui-background README · What it is (and why it does not stutter)：- no DOM scanning, no `MutationObserver`, no per-panel `backdrop-filter`
- turning it off disposes the token layer — the UI returns to the shipped palette
- the wallpaper is **one** `position:fixed; z-index:-1` layer (pure CSS for images, a single `<video>` for video)
section: What it is (and why it does not stutter)

text:
dsh-ui-background README · Features：- Sources: uploaded file, or an absolute local path (read-only; never copied or moved)
- Video wallpapers (`mp4` / `webm`): looped, muted, paused when the tab is hidden
- Framing: `cover` / `contain`, zoom 50–300 %, horizontal/vertical anchor, draggable preview
- Wallpaper Engine: scans the Steam workshop folder `431960` and lists only directly playable entries
- Recents: up to 12 entries with thumbnails **and their framing**, one click to restore, per-entry delete
- Uploaded files can be deleted individually; deleting the active one turns the background off
- Fully local: no network access, no telemetry

dsh-ui-background README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

**Restart the Host afterwards.** DSH builds its module resolution table at startup, so a freshly installed package cannot be imported in the running process.

Then open Settings → **Background & Glass**.

dsh-ui-background README · When this fits：- You want a local image or video behind the UI, with the panels translucent
- You do not want to re-frame after a switch: each history entry keeps its zoom and position

What it cannot do: render Wallpaper Engine scenes. `scene.pkg` needs WE's own engine; this plugin only reads image and video files.

dsh-ui-background README · Limitations：| Limitation | Why |
|---|---|
| Scene wallpapers cannot be used | `scene.pkg` is a Wallpaper Engine format that only its engine can render |
| Do not use WE preview images | Measured at **144–254 px**; stretching to 1920 is a 7–13× upscale |
| Want a WE scene? take a screenshot | Run WE, press `Win+Shift+S`, then use the paste button (1920×1080) |
| `mkv` / `mov` may not play | Edge does not decode those containers; use `mp4` / `webm` |

dsh-ui-background README · Security：- The Host reads only the single local file you configure, plus `project.json` / media / previews inside the Steam workshop folder
- HTTP routes are loopback only; writes reject `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`
- Uploaded file names are sanitised; path traversal is rejected
- State lives in `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-ui-background/` and is **not** removed when the plugin is uninstalled

section: What it is (and why it does not stutter)

text:
dsh-ui-background README · What it is (and why it does not stutter)：- no DOM scanning, no `MutationObserver`, no per-panel `backdrop-filter`
- turning it off disposes the token layer — the UI returns to the shipped palette
- the wallpaper is **one** `position:fixed; z-index:-1` layer (pure CSS for images, a single `<video>` for video)
section: What it is (and why it does not stutter)

text:
dsh-ui-background README · Features：- Sources: uploaded file, or an absolute local path (read-only; never copied or moved)
- Video wallpapers (`mp4` / `webm`): looped, muted, paused when the tab is hidden
- Framing: `cover` / `contain`, zoom 50–300 %, horizontal/vertical anchor, draggable preview
- Wallpaper Engine: scans the Steam workshop folder `431960` and lists only directly playable entries
- Recents: up to 12 entries with thumbnails **and their framing**, one click to restore, per-entry delete
- Uploaded files can be deleted individually; deleting the active one turns the background off
- Fully local: no network access, no telemetry

dsh-ui-background README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

**Restart the Host afterwards.** DSH builds its module resolution table at startup, so a freshly installed package cannot be imported in the running process.

Then open Settings → **Background & Glass**.

dsh-ui-background README · When this fits：- You want a local image or video behind the UI, with the panels translucent
- You do not want to re-frame after a switch: each history entry keeps its zoom and position

What it cannot do: render Wallpaper Engine scenes. `scene.pkg` needs WE's own engine; this plugin only reads image and video files.

dsh-ui-background README · Limitations：| Limitation | Why |
|---|---|
| Scene wallpapers cannot be used | `scene.pkg` is a Wallpaper Engine format that only its engine can render |
| Do not use WE preview images | Measured at **144–254 px**; stretching to 1920 is a 7–13× upscale |
| Want a WE scene? take a screenshot | Run WE, press `Win+Shift+S`, then use the paste button (1920×1080) |
| `mkv` / `mov` may not play | Edge does not decode those containers; use `mp4` / `webm` |

dsh-ui-background README · Security：- The Host reads only the single local file you configure, plus `project.json` / media / previews inside the Steam workshop folder
- HTTP routes are loopback only; writes reject `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`
- Uploaded file names are sanitised; path traversal is rejected
- State lives in `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-ui-background/` and is **not** removed when the plugin is uninstalled
